name: tools
description: General-purpose technical skills (non-marketing). youtube-transcript: read any YouTube video's transcript as plain text, no API key or cookie. apify-fetch: reliable web fetching via Apify (residential IPs, no 403) — YouTube transcripts and full-site crawl to clean markdown; replaces Supadata; needs APIFY_TOKEN. scrapling: web scraping / data extraction via the Scrapling lib (Fetcher decision tree, Cloudflare bypass, login sessions, HTML parsing); needs an open network (local/VPS), not a locked-down web sandbox.
